regional_compliance.tax_context: Federal GST (or harmonized HST in participating provinces) applies to prepared food; some provinces also levy separate provincial sales tax (PST) depending on jurisdiction. Input tax credits can be claimed on GST/HST paid on business purchases.
regional_compliance.labor_regulation: Provincial minimum wage (no federal minimum wage for most private-sector employment); tip-out and tip-pooling rules vary by province, with some provinces (e.g. Ontario) having specific tip protection legislation.
regional_compliance.licensing_bodies: Provincial/municipal health authority (food premises permit), provincial liquor licensing board (if serving alcohol), municipal business license, CRA Business Number for tax purposes.

humanity_mode_regional_addendum.0_percent: GST/HST application and input tax credit claims on prepared food sales, provincial minimum wage and tip protection legislation, provincial health authority permit renewal cycles.

learning_objectives: Understand how GST/HST applies to prepared food sales and how input tax credits offset business GST/HST paid.
Analyze how provincial minimum wage and tip protection rules differ from province to province in Canada.
